tools.name: lite_check
tools.description: Use this when you want a quick free look at a Solana token mint: mint authority, freeze authority, supply and decimals. Rate limited. Facts only, not financial advice. Free, rate limited.

tools.name: check_mint
tools.description: Use this when you need on-chain facts about a Solana SPL token mint before interacting with it: mint and freeze authority, supply, decimals, Token-2022 extensions (transfer fee, permanent delegate, transfer hook...) and factual flags. Facts only, no verdict. Automated facts, not financial advice. Pr

tools.name: holders_pack
tools.description: Use this when you need holder concentration for a Solana token mint: share of supply held by the top 1/5/10/20 largest token accounts, with known liquidity-pool, bonding-curve and burn accounts identified and excluded where determinable. Facts only, no verdict. Automated facts, not financial advice.

tools.name: check_batch
tools.description: Use this when you need the /check facts for up to 10 Solana token mints in one call (comma-separated mints). All-or-nothing: if any mint fails you are not charged. Facts only, not financial advice. Price: $0.08 USDC per call (x402, eip155:8453); pay by attaching an x402 payment in _meta["x402/paymen

tools.name: get_trial_key
tools.description: Use this when you want to try the paid tools without a wallet: returns a key good for 25 free calls of check_mint, holders_pack or check_batch (valid 30 days). Send it in params._meta["trial_key"] or as the X-Trial-Key HTTP header on /mcp. Free, limited per IP.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Use this when you want the current prices, network and payment details for each Mint Facts tool. Free.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_mint, holders_pack, check_batch · Private data: lite_check, check_mint, holders_pack, check_batch, get_trial_key · Public sink: check_mint, holders_pack, check_batch, get_trial_key.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_mint, holders_pack, check_batch · Private data: lite_check, check_mint, holders_pack, check_batch, get_trial_key · Public sink: check_mint, holders_pack, check_batch, get_trial_key

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "check_mint" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
